name: heme o
description: A heme that is heme a with a methyl group in place of the 17-formyl group; the biosynthetic precursor of heme a and the heme of cytochrome bo3 ubiquinol oxidase. The SMARTS pins every heavy atom of the iron-porphyrin skeleton and its substituents by element and heavy-atom degree, so no extra or missing substituents are allowed. Ring, Fe-N and C-O bonds are '~', so Kekule or aromatic, dative or charge-separated, and acid or carboxylate drawings all match. Acyclic C-C bonds keep their order. Iron is left unconstrained, so axial ligands are allowed and the grouping spans both oxidation states. Stereochemistry is not constrained.
